population.span: In a randomized, double-blind, double-dummy trial of 2589 patients with acute VTE treated with low-molecular-weight or unfractionated heparin for 5 to 11 days

endpoint.span: Any bleeding events were defined as major, clinically-relevant and nuisance bleeding events.

estimate.span: Any bleeding occurred in 200 dabigatran (15.6%) and 285 warfarin (22.1%; hazard ratio, 0.67; 95% CI, 0.56-0.81) patients.

analysis_set.span: POPULATION: Treated set (TS): consisted of all randomised patients who were documented to have taken at least one dose of study drug. Patients were assigned to the treatment groups as treated.

treatment_strategy.span: we compared dabigatran 150 mg twice daily with warfarin.

follow_up.span: did not fulfil the criteria from above. | TIME FRAME: From first intake of study drug to last intake of study drug + 6 days washout

candidate_rejections.why: Pooled RE-COVER + RE-COVER II estimate, not this trial alone; using it would double-count RE-COVER (PMID 19966341, served separately as M-11).

candidate_rejections.span: The safety end point, major bleeding, occurred in 15 patients receiving dabigatran (1.2%) and in 22 receiving warfarin (1.7%; hazard ratio, 0.69; 95% CI, 0.36-1.32).

entry_population_matches_question.why: Adults (18 or older) with acute symptomatic proximal DVT and/or PE; comparator warfarin.
entry_population_matches_question.span: Acute symptomatic uni- or bilateral Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) of the leg involving proximal veins, and/or Pulmonary Embolism (PE) * Male or female, being 18 years of age or older

notes: RE-COVER II (NCT00680186). Served row 0.67 (0.56-0.81) matches this trial's any-bleeding HR in both the abstract and registry Outcome 7 Analysis 1 (Treated set, 200/1280 vs 285/1288). n_t/n_c are left null because they are not printed in the estimate span. The endpoint definition comes from the registry because the abstract names 'any bleeding' without defining it. The europepmc_core.json abstract is truncated after the primary outcome (cut at 'P') and does not carry the bleeding results.
